source_limits: The own history attributes congressional land-purchase authority to 1906 and a later land purchase to 1908. These are administrative stages, not an origin date for the peoples, a current title finding or a claim that an acreage remains unchanged.

The own Council page separately dates organization under Articles of Association to 1961 and Constitution approval to June 2008. The full Articles, Constitution, amendments and present legal effect were not independently reviewed; no current officeholder or participation rule is inferred.

The Cultural Resources page is undated. It supports the stated priorities and educational partnerships without establishing a current class schedule, enrollment eligibility, start date, teaching content, fluency outcome or cultural-use permission.

The Environmental Program attributes the pier replacement and engineered stormwater feature to 2012. This establishes no present maintenance condition, measured runoff capture, water-quality result, current permit compliance or public-access guarantee.

The homepage includes an old propositions notice and an undated long-range transportation planning invitation. Neither is treated as a current election instruction, completed plan or verified deadline.

The cultural page describes long-term plans for an oral-history project and cultural center or museum. No completed building, completed oral-history collection or permission to reproduce knowledge is inferred.
The history’s cultural descriptions and references to sacred places are not reproduced or mapped. Posted personnel, contact information, meeting details and restricted member paths are excluded.
The own Council page supports a general location near Trinidad; the own history places the Rancheria in Humboldt County. No boundary, jurisdiction or exclusive ancestral-territory finding is made.
